## Gap analysis vs spec
- **§5b.1 grammar/message** — `ModelEvent` G1–G7 + `collect` T1–T7 landed
  (`grammar.rs`, `message.rs`); opaque blocks pass through; unparseable tool
  calls are typed, never repaired.
- **§5b.1 vocabularies** — `StopReason`, `ModelErrorClass` (kernel
  `retry_class` defaults + narrowing-only `retry_class_override`),
  `RetryClass`, `BlockKind`, `NoticeKind`, `UsageArrival`, `Purpose`,
  `RerouteReason`, cache kinds/miss reasons all closed (`vocab.rs`).
- **§5b.1 dialect** — `WireDialect/1` strict codec (`dialect.rs`); every
  textual rule requires a complete debt record or the document fails to load;
  `stop_reason_map`/`error_text_to_class` are data (ADR-0253 §5).
- **§5b.1 attempts** — `AttemptPolicy` as data + R-RT-1…6 driver
  (`attempts.rs`); identical bytes per R-RT-3; permanent/ambiguous never
  retried.
- **§5b.1 gateway** — `ModelGateway` over `Transport`/`CredentialPort`/
  `EventSink` ports (`gateway.rs`): dialect+plan gate, allowlist admission
  before dispatch, budget reservation before bytes leave, usage on
  `model.call.completed`, typed `ModelError` terminal. Live transports and
  the recording variant's suite harness are Stage-2/3 seams — DF-S1.18-1/-2.
- **§5b.2 router (C0)** — `RoutingPolicy{static|role_table}`,
  `ModelRoleTable`, `RoleBinding`, `select` over `SelectorView`/`BudgetPort`/
  `HealthView` ports, closed `RoutingRefusal`, typed candidate verdicts,
  `model.route.decided` + `reroute()` builder (`router.rs`). Non-static
  policy kinds, G-3/G-5/G-6 producers and the kernel emitter call sites are
  staged later — DF-S1.18-1.
- **§5b.3 profile (C0)** — `ModelProfile/1` reconciled in `hh-compiler`
  (additive, not duplicated): `VersionPattern::Range{family, lo?, hi?}` per
  the spec spelling, `ModelCoordinate`, `selector_matches`, `SelectorView`,
  `resolve_profile` + closed refusals, null profile, expiry state machine +
  status payloads. `ProbeSpec` execution/`probe_profile` and
  `ProfileTestReport` consumption are Stage-3 — DF-S1.18-2.
- **§5b.4 cache/layout (C0)** — `CacheSemantics` as data, `derive_affinity_key`,
  `place_markers` (cap/drop/substitution accounting), `expect_cache_state`
  (conservative: below-min ⇒ `uncacheable`; undeclared ⇒ `unknown`;
  in-flight sibling ⇒ `cold{concurrent_sibling}`), `observe_cache_state`,
  LC-1…LC-9 checkers (`cache.rs`, `layout.rs`), `model.cache.resolved`
  payload. K4/K5 stores and the run-projection halves are Stage-2+ —
  DF-S1.18-1/-2.
- **Ledger classes** — `model.rerouted` + `model.profile.expired_used`
  registered in `CLASS_TABLE` as `model_io`-origin rows (`hh-ledger`
  `classes.rs`); the pre-existing `model.call.*`/`model.route.decided`/
  `model.cache.resolved`/`model.profile.*` rows verified against the payload
  builders.

## CC1–CC10 analysis
- **CC1** — one scheme per concern: usage normalization reuses
  `hh-telemetry`'s `TokenVector`/`ProviderUsage`; charge-side model identity
  reuses `hh_budget::ModelRef` via `charge_ref()` — no parallel attribution
  record (ADR-0253 §2).
- **CC2** — credentials flow through `CredentialPort`; payloads carry
  `provided`/`binding_ref` only; the gateway holds no secret material
  (`endpoint_admission_and_no_secret_material`).
- **CC3** — nothing silently lost: `Unparseable{raw}` preserves bytes;
  `raw_stop_reason`/`surface_ids` preserve provider spellings; dropped
  markers are recorded; `available=false` usage is typed, never a zero.
- **CC4** — all records canonical JSON over the closed vocabularies;
  `plan_hash`/`content_hash`/`affinity_key` derive through the canonical
  hashing path.
- **CC5** — contract-only reach: the gateway consumes `hh-compiler`'s public
  `ModelProfile`/`SelectorView`, `hh-budget`'s `Account`, `hh-ledger`'s class
  table; no internals poked.
- **CC6** — the dialect/profile/policy records carry their semantics as data;
  a `natural` cache posture on an unsupported dialect is refused, not
  coerced; capability `unknown` is never `unmet` (ADR-0253 §4).
- **CC7** — `VersionPattern`, `RoutingRefusal`, the class rows and the LC
  checks are the machine-checked form of §5b; a spec change is a code change
  here.
- **CC8** — additive-only: `hh-gateway` is a new crate; `profile.rs`/`schema.rs`
  changes are additive reconciliations (`Range` variant re-spelled to the
  spec record); ledger classes appended; closed sums keep the C1 members
  (`CapabilityUnmet`, non-static policy kinds) declared.
- **CC9** — matched-budget-or-refuse: `select` requires a reservation
  (G-4) before a decision succeeds; the gateway requires one before bytes
  leave; `unknown` states (`expect_cache_state`, capabilities) surface
  typed, never fabricated.
- **CC10** — `hh-gateway` is its own crate at `home = model_boundary`; the
  compiler never depends on it; usage/cost provenance is emitted only by the
  gateway; routing policy stays in the router, never in the codec.

## Deviations
- `select` is a free function over ports (`SelectorView`/`BudgetPort`/
  `HealthView` adapters) rather than a service trait — the seam stays pure
  for AC-R-2.3.2-11 determinism — ADR-0253 §3.
- The gateway request-side `ModelRef` and `hh_budget`'s charge-side
  `ModelRef` coexist as two records with an explicit `charge_ref()`
  conversion — one scheme, two concerns — ADR-0253 §2.
- `VersionPattern::Range` re-spelled from the landed pair to the spec's
  `range(family, lo?, hi?)` record — a same-ticket schema reconciliation,
  not a landed-file rewrite (the variant was never released outside the
  chain tip) — ADR-0253 §8.
